import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {
    "m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
    "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
}

path = "budget.xlsx"
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("FILES:", names)

    # shared strings
    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in root.findall("m:si", NS):
            text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t"))
            shared.append(text)

    # workbook sheet list + relationships
    wb_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    sheets = [(s.get("name"), s.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id"))
              for s in wb_root.findall("m:sheets/m:sheet", NS)]
    print("SHEETS:", sheets)

    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rel_map = {r.get("Id"): r.get("Target") for r in rels}

    def col_to_idx(ref):
        m = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", ref)
        letters = m.group(1)
        idx = 0
        for ch in letters:
            idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - ord("A") + 1)
        return idx - 1  # 0-based

    for name, rid in sheets:
        target = rel_map[rid]
        if not target.startswith("xl/"):
            target = "xl/" + target.lstrip("/")
        data = z.read(target)
        root = ET.fromstring(data)
        print(f"=== Sheet: {name} ===")
        rows = []
        for row in root.findall(".//m:sheetData/m:row", NS):
            cells = {}
            for c in row.findall("m:c", NS):
                ref = c.get("r")
                t = c.get("t")
                v = c.find("m:v", NS)
                val = None
                if t == "s" and v is not None:
                    val = shared[int(v.text)]
                elif v is not None:
                    val = v.text
                cells[col_to_idx(ref)] = val
            rows.append(cells)
        max_col = max((max(r.keys()) for r in rows), default=-1)
        for r in rows:
            print([r.get(i) for i in range(max_col + 1)])
        print()
